# Rakesh Patel

> Full-Stack Engineer working in AI-native product development and SaaS engineering, based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Ships production web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js — building both LLM-backed features and multi-tenant SaaS systems with authentication, role-based access, and subscription tiers. This file indexes the site's core pages, projects, and articles for LLM consumption.

Rakesh Patel is a Nepal-based full-stack engineer working across two connected disciplines: AI-native product development and SaaS engineering. His AI practice covers LLM-backed product features, analysis pipelines, agentic development workflows, and interfaces designed around model output. His SaaS practice covers the architecture that recurring-revenue products require — authentication, role-based access control, multi-tenant data modeling, dashboards, quotas, and usage tiers. Most of his shipped work sits at the intersection: SaaS products with AI-powered features, and AI tooling delivered as a hosted product. Work spans recruitment SaaS, developer tools, FinTech, EdTech, and fleet operations, with several projects published as in-depth case studies covering architecture, tradeoffs, and outcomes. His writing covers agentic AI development, LLM tooling, and MERN architecture.

## Projects

- [Ishirable.com](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/ishirablecom): AI-powered platform that analyzes public GitHub activity and converts it into recruiter-focused hiring signals with clear improvement insights. LLM analysis pipeline over third-party data.
- [SnapHost](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/snaphost): Instant file hosting that turns an image or PDF into a clean, shareable link in seconds, with no account required. Anonymous uploads auto-expire after 24 hours; registered users get custom URLs and a management dashboard.
- [Ledg - Smart Spend](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/ledg-smart-spend): Personal finance app for tracking income, expenses, lending, and borrowing across multiple financial spaces, with server-side aggregation for spending analytics.
- [Academix](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/academix): Academic management system for tracking enrolled students, courses, and teachers assigned to each course, with role-based dashboards.
- [Otrack](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/otrack): Order tracking system for creating orders for multiple clients in bulk across different date periods, with delivery scheduling.

## Blog

- [AI-First Development and Agentic Workflows](https://rakeshpatel.me/blog/ai-first-development-and-agentic-workflows): How AI agents reshape the software development lifecycle, from prompt-driven scaffolding to multi-agent systems.
- [I Let AI Build My React App](https://rakeshpatel.me/blog/ai-built-my-react-app): What worked, what failed, and what still required manual coding when AI agents built a React app.
- [The God of AI in 2026 - Why Anthropic Is So Hard to Ignore](https://rakeshpatel.me/blog/the-god-of-ai-in-2026-why-anthropic-is-so-hard-to-ignore): Analysis of Anthropic's position in coding, reasoning, and agentic workflows.
- [The market dominance of MERN in 2026](https://rakeshpatel.me/blog/the-market-dominance-of-mern-in-2026): Why the MERN stack remains dominant through its unified JavaScript stack and cloud readiness.
- [Imposter Syndrome Reflections](https://rakeshpatel.me/blog/imposter-syndrome-reflections): Personal exploration of imposter syndrome and coping strategies for building supportive communities.

## Case Studies

In-depth engineering write-ups covering architecture, challenges, solutions, and results.

- [Ishirable.com Case Study](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/ishirablecom): How public GitHub activity is turned into recruiter-focused hiring signals.
- [SnapHost Case Study](https://rakeshpatel.me/projects/snaphost): System design for the upload-to-link pipeline, including signed uploads, rate limiting, and quota enforcement.
